rows.label: qst650302_msg0001
rows.name: There they are, all right.

rows.label: qst650302_msg0002
rows.name: There are a lot of them...

rows.label: qst650302_msg0003
rows.name:
That's a lot of Garlus
in such a tight space.

rows.label: qst650302_msg0004
rows.name: Looks toasty warm.

rows.label: qst650302_msg0005
rows.name:
Yeah... I bet they came down
here to get away from the cold.

rows.label: qst650302_msg0006
rows.name:
But this isn't the time to joke
around.

rows.label: qst650302_msg0007
rows.name: Right. We have to beat them all.

rows.label: qst650302_msg0008
rows.name: Wait, mo. Tora just had an idea, mo.

rows.label: qst650302_msg0009
rows.name: Oh?

rows.label: qst650302_msg0010
rows.name:
We want to stop bad people from
getting near the Sanctus Chain, mo?

rows.label: qst650302_msg0011
rows.name:
Then instead of soldiers, why not have
the Garlus stay here, mo?

rows.label: qst650302_msg0012
rows.name: Master, that's a great idea, mo.

rows.label: qst650302_msg0013
rows.name:
If these Garlus can repel even the
Luxurian army, ordinary Drivers won't
be able to get near, mo.

rows.label: qst650302_msg0014
rows.name: I see.

rows.label: qst650302_msg0015
rows.name: No, no...

rows.label: qst650302_msg0016
rows.name:
It'd be a problem if some clever
Garlus started controlling Genbu,
right?

rows.label: qst650302_msg0017
rows.name: Mo-mo-mo... Kamuya's right, mo.

rows.label: qst650302_msg0018
rows.name:
There are a lot of them, but we've got
to do it.

rows.label: qst650302_msg0019
rows.name: Yeah.

rows.label: qst650302_msg0020
rows.name: Then let's go!
